$comment: This company's whole work environment is five role-scoped MCP servers from the `opencompany-tau2` repo, each serving one slice of the tau2-bench retail domain over streamable HTTP and all five sharing ONE state file under an exclusive flock. They ship DISABLED with placeholder https endpoints, because a bundle in this repo must not point an agent at a host nobody has provisioned. For a LOCAL run, leave them disabled here and register the loopback endpoints at runtime — `PUT /mcp/servers/{name}` is the only layer that accepts an http:// endpoint. `scripts/tau2-sim.py --domain retail` does exactly that.

tau2-retail-triage.description: Read-only front desk: find a user from name and zip, read their orders, read product and stock detail. Nine tools, none of which mutate.

tau2-retail-exchanges.description: Delivered orders, remedy = exchange: swap an item for another variant of the same product. One mutating tool; holds no refund tool.

tau2-retail-refunds.description: Delivered orders, remedy = refund: take items back. One mutating tool; holds no exchange tool.

tau2-retail-cancellations.description: Pending orders, remedy = cancel the whole order. One mutating tool; holds no modify tool.

tau2-retail-amendments.description: Pending orders, remedy = amend in place (items, address, payment). Three mutating tools; holds no cancel tool.
